name: Level-select path reveal
oneLiner: An overworld map between levels: level, secret, castle, save-hut, shop and bonus nodes joined by paths; the hero walks node to node along the paths; cleared levels change colour and fly a flag; clearing a level draws the next path stone by stone with a sound per stone while the camera follows, a secret exit opens a different path, locked paths show faint, an info panel names the node and its collected items, huts save through the game, and the map scrolls when it is bigger than the screen.
fits: action or puzzle games with a stage list
any game with 3+ levels or arenas to string together
notFor: games with a single endless level

needs: a scene switch: title -> map -> level -> map (the game shows the map scene between levels)
the graph: nodes {id, x, y, kind, name} in map pixels and edges {a, b, via, exit}
the cleared state to start from (or none for a new game)
enterLevel(id): start that level; and a call back to complete(id, exit) or fail(id) when the level ends
input on the map: 4 directions (held) and a confirm press
a fixed 60 Hz update step while the map is shown
optional: onSave(state) for huts, onShop(id), onSound(name), nodeInfo(id) items for the panel
provides: events arrive / leave / reveal / revealDone / clear / save / shop / deny / allClear via onEvent
sound cue names: step, arrive, dot, open, enter, save, shop, deny
state {at, cleared, open, saves} for saving
data player anchor on screen, UI rects (panel, toasts), camera offset
autopilot that walks to the next uncleared level and enters it

assets: none: terrain, hero, node buildings, stones, icons and windows are drawn by code in the module
